messages:
alex: Quick follow-up to the routing policy RFC. Two customer incidents where cost-first selection picked a low-cost variant whose latency suddenly spiked. Need a practical hardening for the policy engine.

maya: Short story: runtime provided no health hint, policy fell back to cost tie-breaker, p99 blew up and frontend timed out.

sam: We saw the same on traces. Policy lacked a safety signal from runtimes.

eli: Proposal: add minimal canonical signals on route descriptors: runtime.capacity_score (0-1), runtime.p99_probe_ms, runtime.signal_ts. Policy treats missing as conservative.

jordan: Add staleness handling: if signal_ts older than 15s age capacity_score toward 0.2.

rachel: UX ask: Console should show normalized fields and a simulated decision preview so SREs can verify mappings.

alex: Draft policy sketch: prefer same-region if capacity_score>=0.6 && p99_probe_ms<=300; else if capacity_score>=0.4 && cost_delta<=0.15 try primary; else hedge N=1 preferring latency up to cost_cap=0.25.

maya: Need consistent p99 windows (we use 1m rolling for steady, 10s probe for immediate). Adapter must specify which field is which.

sam: Rollout: implement a compiler adapter to normalize runtime payloads -> canonical fields so we don't break runtimes immediately. Backwards compat: missing metrics map to capacity_score=0.3, p99_probe_ms=9999, signal_ts=now-60s.

eli: Ops: run a 30d sim against production traces to estimate egress/cost impact of hedging. I'll own the sim if you give the mapping.
jordan: Add alerts: region.capacity_score_drop and routing.hedge_rate_spike. Ops-bot: create alerts.

ops-bot: @jordan created alert: "region.capacity_score_drop" threshold=30% window=60s.

rachel: Make hedging opt-in per-tenant initially; Console opt-in should show expected egress delta. Optimize team should provide per-tenant cost sim.

alex: Action items: eli -> mapping doc + sim inputs (ETA Wed); sam -> unit tests + adapter PR (ETA Thu); maya -> RFC follow-up and rollout notes (ETA Tue); rachel -> Console preview mock (ETA Mon).

sam: I'll open the follow-up PR and attach sim plan unless anyone objects.

maya: No objections. Marking this accepted for the rollout track.

alex: Thanks everyone.
